saw_lines: Nobody buys a sofa on impulse. They compare prices and fabric options across stores, then visit one to sit on it.
So the sale is won in the ad, where a buyer decides whether the price is worth a trip.
Your site shows 15,000+ customers, yet 0 of 30 ads carry that number. Put 15,000+ customers on every creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 15,000+ customers, yet 0 of 30 ads carry that number. Cold viewers have no reason to trust a store they have never visited. Put 15,000+ customers on every creative and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers percent off, yet 0 of 27 ads mention it. Buyers scroll past a sofa without a reason to click. Put percent off in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

7 of 27 copy ads open on the same line, Furnishka is trusted by 25,000+ happy customers, and the rest are single use. Repeats wear the claim thin. Test two new angles against it: price comparison and the store visit.

3 ads have run 60+ days, and the oldest is the Better Value video, live since June 2026. Winners fatigue, so new variations are the backup. Build three variations of it that open on delivery, which only 2 ads mention.

ads_1: Price comparison and store visit openers, with the 15,000+ customers number on every creative
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, X and YouTube
